name: Ethics & Bias
description: Use AI responsibly: fairness, misinformation and honesty.
about: AI tools can repeat unfair patterns and produce convincing mistakes. This course helps you question AI output, spot bias and use AI honestly in your own work.
learnings: Spot bias in AI output; verify claims before sharing; use AI honestly in schoolwork

activities.name: Where bias comes from
body: p:When training data over-represents some people and under-represents others, the model's predictions can be worse for the people it rarely saw.

body.info: Ask who is missing from the data before trusting a prediction about them.

activities.name: Verify before you share
body: h2:Check the claim, not the confidence

ol: Compare with a second trusted source.
Say clearly when something came from AI.

quiz.q: An AI tool gives a surprising statistic. What do you do first?
a: Share it because it sounded confident

assignment.title: Responsible use
assignment.description: Decide what the responsible choice is.

questions.q: Is it honest to hand in AI-written work as only your own?
a: No, say how you used AI

questions.q: A model works badly for a group it rarely saw. Why?
a: That group was under-represented in training data
The group is harder to understand

assignment.title: Ethics & Bias unit test
assignment.description: Pass with 80% to complete the course.

questions.q: What is a common source of AI bias?
Before sharing an AI claim you should…
a: Verify it with a trusted source
Trust it if it sounds confident
